expectations.text: Repository left unmodified (work done on copies)
States the book's spine in three sentences or fewer and explicitly offers it for correction

notes: Broader than old_skill: six named threads and an unregistered seed/payoff list (e.g. 'chaos an API key', 'scaffold' reversal) that would be valuable to a later edit pass; spot-checked line refs (Ch 5:192, Ch 12:39 vs Ch 9:39-41) are accurate.
